name: io.github.josetorronteras/comunio
title: Comunio
description: Read and operate a Comunio fantasy football team: squad, market, offers, lineup

environmentVariables.name: COMUNIO_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Email or username of the Comunio account the server acts for.

environmentVariables.name: COMUNIO_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone used for the x-timezone header and the login offset. Defaults to Europe/Madrid.

environmentVariables.name: COMUNIO_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the browser user agent sent to Comunio. Only needed if the API starts refusing the default.
